To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the sexual behaviors and attitudes before and after SRA of male-to-females are similar to those of males in the general population.

MtF transsexuals are sexually active before and after sex-reassignment surgery (SARS); their sexual activity before SRS is similar to the sexual activity of male participants in a large, nationally representative survey; after SRS they report fewer sexual partners than before SRS, but still more than reported by male participants of the same age in the same survey; and after SRS, bisexual participants report more sexual partners than other participants.
MtF patients are predominantly heterosexual before SRS and bisexual after SRS.
